stories.title: Helen MacArthur appointed chief fire officer of North Wales Fire and Rescue Service
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service’s next chief fire officer will be a finance and governance specialist who joined the service eight years ago. stories.title: Risso’s dolphin put down in North Wales after public refloated it before medics arrived
stories.summary: A young Risso’s dolphin was put down on a beach at Penmaenmawr after members of the public dragged it back into the sea before marine medics could assess it. stories.title: Half of Connah’s Quay power station was out on the night Britain ran short of electricity
stories.summary: Half of Connah’s Quay power station was out of action on the night whistleblowers claimed Britain’s electricity grid was not being run securely during June’s heatwave. stories.title: Police appeal to identify person after incident at Quay Shopping Centre in Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: Police have released a CCTV image of a person they want to identify following an incident at the Quay Shopping Centre in Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Clogau poppy pins on sale at Broughton store to raise money for Army Benevolent Fund
stories.summary: Limited-edition poppy pins raising money for the Army Benevolent Fund are going on sale at Clogau’s Broughton store ahead of Remembrance Sunday. The Bodelwyddan-based jewellery company, known for using Welsh gold, has produced 10,000 pins for 2026, the third year of the campaign.
